source_caption:
🎬 Bad Apples (2025)

Bad Apples follows Maria, a dedicated primary school teacher whose increasingly stressful professional life begins spiraling out of control when she struggles to manage a particularly disruptive student. Already overwhelmed by the demands of teaching, difficult classroom behavior, and the pressure to maintain order, Maria finds herself pushed to her emotional limits as one student’s actions repeatedly interfere with her ability to teach the rest of the class. What begins as an ordinary workplace frustration soon takes a shocking turn when Maria makes an impulsive decision that creates an extraordinary moral dilemma. Suddenly caught in a situation far beyond anything she could have imagined, she attempts to regain control while hiding the consequences of her actions from colleagues, parents, and the surrounding community. As events become increasingly complicated, Maria must confront uncomfortable questions about responsibility, discipline, personal boundaries, and the lengths someone might go to protect their own peace of mind. Through absurd situations, escalating tension, and moments of dark humor, the film examines the pressures placed on educators and the unpredictable consequences of decisions made in desperation. Starring Saoirse Ronan, Bad Apples combines psychological suspense, sharp social satire, and uncomfortable comedy to explore morality, frustration, authority, guilt, and the thin line between maintaining control and completely losing it.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Thriller • Dark Comedy

🎥 Director: Jonatan Etzler

✍️ Writer: Jess O’Kane, based on the novel by Rasmus Lindgren

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 40m • R

📅 Release: Premiered in 2025; released theatrically in the United States in September 2026

📺 Where to Watch: Available to rent or buy on Amazon Prime Video and Fandango at Home in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Bad Apples is a 2025 dark comedy thriller film directed by Jonatan Etzler and written by Jess O'Kane, based on the 2020 novel De Oönskade by Rasmus Lindgren. It stars Saoirse Ronan, Eddie Waller, Nia Brown, Jacob Anderson, Rakie Ayola, Robert Emms, Sean Gilder, and Kerry Howard. Bad Apples premiered in the United Kingdom and the United States on September 18, 2026. The film received positive reviews from critics.
